items.title: Solana fees hit record as validators double pace of inflation cuts

items.title: OpenSea adds Solana NFT trading more than four years after initial beta
items.summary: OpenSea has added support for Solana NFTs, allowing users to buy, sell, and trade the blockchain's digital collectibles on its platform.

items.title: Solana Will Now Print Less SOL as Disinflation Vote Passes in Dramatic Fashion

items.title: Charles Schwab Expands Crypto Trading Beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum

items.title: Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026

items.title: Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic
